source_audits.source_name: Live Major Applications not previously considered by Committee at 14.04.26
source_audits.source_type: official local authority live/current major planning applications PDF
source_audits.coverage_note: Reviewed the April 2026 live-major list for Belfast architecture, housing, education, care, infrastructure, public-realm, harbour and community-facility applications that were not found in the seed milestone file or Belfast round118-120 packs by application reference.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Belfast City Council public committee PDF; council website copyright and terms apply. This scratch pack stores factual row metadata, short paraphrases and source links only.
source_audits.reliability: High for application reference, location, proposal text, Date Valid, Target Date and status as listed in the official current-major-applications PDF.
source_audits.date_caveats: The Date Valid field is an application-process date, not a permission, construction, completion, occupation or opening date.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: The PDF gives addresses and broad site descriptions but not reusable surveyed coordinates or red-line boundaries. Coordinates in this pack are approximate triage points from address lookup or existing local atlas context.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as application-stage records only. Show as current/under-consideration records and do not count as approved, built or occupied changes.

source_audits.source_type: official local authority planning decisions-issued PDF
source_audits.coverage_note: Reviewed the September 2025 decisions-issued list for architecture-related non-duplicate permissions, listed-building consents and condition/variation decisions.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Belfast City Council public PDF; council website copyright and terms apply. This scratch pack stores factual row metadata, short paraphrases and source links only.
source_audits.reliability: High for application reference, location, proposal text and decision status as listed in the monthly decisions-issued PDF.
source_audits.date_caveats: This pass uses month precision from the monthly decisions-issued PDF where a row-level decision day was not separately extracted. A Planning Portal follow-up should confirm exact decision-notice dates.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: The PDF gives addresses but not reusable coordinates or site polygons. Coordinates are approximate address/site points.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as month-precision planning-decision milestones unless Planning Portal validation supplies exact decision-issued dates and better geometry.

source_audits.source_type: non-official geometry aid used only for approximate address/site points
source_audits.coverage_note: Used only to place approximate WGS84 point coordinates for candidate triage where Belfast City Council PDFs supplied addresses but not coordinates.
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: OpenStreetMap data is available under ODbL. Any production use of OSM-derived coordinates should include OSM attribution and comply with ODbL requirements.
source_audits.reliability: Usable with caveats for approximate site navigation points; not authoritative planning geometry.
source_audits.date_caveats: OSM/geocoding dates are not event dates and must not be used as evidence of real-world change.
source_audits.geometry_caveats: Address search results may snap to streets, named premises, campuses or nearby features. Replace with NI Planning Portal easting/northing or red-line geometry before production import where possible.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Treat only as interim geometry_source support, not as source evidence for the planning records.
